summary.text: Jamie Ray Gragg is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 140 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Gragg owns and operates a woodworking business in Christian County.

paragraphs.text: Jamie Ray Gragg lives in Christian County, Missouri, and graduated from Ozark High School.
He earned an undergraduate degree from Southwest Baptist University in 1996 and a graduate degree from Southwest Baptist Theological Seminary.
His career experience includes owning and operating his own woodworking business.
Gragg took office on January 4, 2023, succeeding Tricia Derges.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Elementary and Secondary Education, Children and Families, Commerce, Fiscal Review and Ethics committees and as vice chair of the House General Laws Committee.
